region.description: Select EU if your Hedy account uses EU data residency.

topicId.description: Optionally filter results by a specific topic.

after.description: Pagination cursor used to fetch results after a specific item.

before.description: Pagination cursor used to fetch results before a specific item.

list-session-highlights.name: list-session-highlights
list-session-highlights.description: Retrieve highlights for a specific session.

sessionId.description: The session ID as shown in the Hedy dashboard.

returnAll.description: Return all results instead of using the limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50).

get-todo.name: get-todo
get-todo.description: Retrieve a specific todo by ID.

sessionId.description: The session ID as shown in the Hedy dashboard.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single todo from a Hedy session by its ID. Requires both the owning session ID (prefixed "sess_") and the todo ID. Read-only and idempotent.

list-todos.description: Retrieve todos assigned to you in Hedy.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50).

list-session-todos.name: list-session-todos
list-session-todos.description: Retrieve todos generated for a specific session.

returnAll.description: Return all results instead of using the limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50).

aiMetadata.description: List the todos generated for one specific Hedy session, identified by a session ID (must be prefixed with "sess_"). Use when you have a session and want only its todos, rather than the account-wide list. Read-only and idempotent.

get-topic.name: get-topic
get-topic.description: Retrieve details for a specific topic.

topicId.description: The topic ID as shown in the Hedy dashboard.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single Hedy topic by its ID (must be prefixed with "topic_"). Use when you already have a topic ID and need its details. Read-only and idempotent.

list-topics.name: list-topics
list-topics.description: Retrieve all topics from your Hedy workspace.

returnAll.description: Return all results instead of using the limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50).

list-topic-sessions.name: list-topic-sessions
list-topic-sessions.description: Retrieve sessions associated with a specific topic.

topicId.description: The topic ID as shown in the Hedy dashboard.

returnAll.description: Return all results instead of using the limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50).

aiMetadata.description: List the sessions assigned to one specific Hedy topic, identified by a topic ID (must be prefixed with "topic_"). Read-only and idempotent.

create-topic.name: create-topic
create-topic.description: Create a new topic for organizing sessions.

color.description: Hex color code for the topic (e.g. #4A90D9).

topicContext.description: Custom instructions for AI processing of sessions in this topic (max 20,000 characters).

aiMetadata.description: Create a new Hedy topic for organizing sessions, with a required name plus optional description, color, icon, and AI processing instructions. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate topic even with identical input.

topicId.description: The topic ID as shown in the Hedy dashboard.

name.description: New name for the topic (max 100 characters).

color.description: Hex color code for the topic.

topicContext.description: Custom instructions for AI processing (max 20,000 characters). Leave empty to clear.

aiMetadata.description: Update fields on an existing Hedy topic identified by a topic ID (must be prefixed with "topic_"); only the fields you provide are changed, and at least one must be supplied. Idempotent: repeating the same update leaves the topic in the same state.

topicId.description: The topic ID as shown in the Hedy dashboard.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete a Hedy topic identified by a topic ID (must be prefixed with "topic_"). Idempotent in effect: once deleted, repeating the call leaves the topic absent (a repeat may error if the topic no longer exists).

create-context.name: create-context
create-context.description: Create a new session context with AI instructions.

title.description: Title of the session context (max 200 characters).

content.description: Instructions or context for AI analysis (max 20,000 characters).

isDefault.description: Whether this context should be the default for new sessions.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new Hedy session context (a reusable set of AI instructions applied to sessions), with a required title plus optional content and a default flag. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate context even with identical input.

get-context.name: get-context
get-context.description: Retrieve a specific session context by ID.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single Hedy session context by its ID (must be prefixed with "ctx_"). Use when you already have a context ID and need its details. Read-only and idempotent.

returnAll.description: Return all results instead of using the limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50).

aiMetadata.description: List all Hedy session contexts in the account. Use to discover contexts or find a context ID before getting, updating, or deleting one. Set Return All to fetch everything, otherwise results are capped by the limit. Read-only and idempotent.

title.description: New title for the session context (max 200 characters).

content.description: Instructions or context for AI analysis (max 20,000 characters).

isDefault.description: Whether this context should be the default for new sessions.

aiMetadata.description: Update fields on an existing Hedy session context identified by a context ID (must be prefixed with "ctx_"); only the fields you provide are changed, and at least one must be supplied. Idempotent: repeating the same update leaves the context in the same state.

Permanently delete a Hedy session context identified by a context ID (must be prefixed with "ctx_"). Idempotent in effect: once deleted, repeating the call leaves the context absent (a repeat may error if the context no longer exists).

session-created.name: session-created
session-created.description: Triggers when a new session is created in Hedy.

verifySignature.description: Verify the webhook signature using the secret returned by Hedy. Disable this option if Hedy does not provide a signing secret for your account.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new meeting session is created in Hedy, before it has ended. Represents the start of a session and carries the new session record.

session-ended.name: session-ended
session-ended.description: Triggers when a session is completed in Hedy.

verifySignature.description: Verify the webhook signature using the secret returned by Hedy. Disable this option if Hedy does not provide a signing secret for your account.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a Hedy meeting session is completed (ended), representing a finished session whose transcript and AI-generated outputs are available. Use this rather than Session Created when you need the full results of a meeting.

session-exported.name: session-exported
session-exported.description: Triggers when a user manually exports a session via the app. Payload includes exportedAt instead of endTime.

verifySignature.description: Verify the webhook signature using the secret returned by Hedy. Disable this option if Hedy does not provide a signing secret for your account.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a user manually exports a Hedy session from the app, representing a deliberate export action (distinct from a session simply ending). The payload carries an exportedAt timestamp in place of endTime.

highlight-created.name: highlight-created
highlight-created.description: Triggers when a highlight is created during a session.

verifySignature.description: Verify the webhook signature using the secret returned by Hedy. Disable this option if Hedy does not provide a signing secret for your account.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a highlight is captured during a Hedy session, representing a single newly created highlight and its parent session. Use to react to highlights as they happen mid-meeting.

todo-exported.name: todo-exported
todo-exported.description: Triggers when a todo item is exported from Hedy.

verifySignature.description: Verify the webhook signature using the secret returned by Hedy. Disable this option if Hedy does not provide a signing secret for your account.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a todo item is exported from Hedy, representing a single exported todo. Use to forward action items to an external task system as they are exported.
